answer: One workable design: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because ripple only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
